summary: IMS batch purge for the authorization module: deletes expired pending-authorization messages. It walks the IMS pending-authorization database (summary root segments, each with detail child segments); for each detail it checks whether it is older than the expiry window (parameter, default 5 days) and deletes qualifying details. When a summary has no remaining approved authorizations it deletes the summary too. Takes IMS checkpoints at a configurable frequency for restartability and prints counts of records read and deleted.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Initialize (read run parameters and today's date). Find the first pending-auth summary. Loop over summaries until error or end of database: for each summary, walk its detail segments; check each detail for expiry and delete the qualified ones; if the summary has no approved authorizations left, delete the summary; every N summaries take a checkpoint. After all summaries, take a final checkpoint, print the read/deleted counts, and return.

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: a pending-auth summary is deleted once it has no approved authorizations remaining.

paragraphs.notes: BUSINESS-CRITICAL: expiry-based purge driver over an IMS hierarchy.

paragraphs.name: 1000-INITIALIZE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Accept the current date and Julian day, read the SYSIN parameter card, and apply defaults: expiry days default to 5 if the parameter is non-numeric; checkpoint frequency defaults to 5; display frequency defaults to 10; debug flag defaults to 'N'.

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: the pending-authorization expiry window defaults to 5 days when not supplied as a parameter.

paragraphs.name: 2000-FIND-NEXT-AUTH-SUMMARY
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read (GN) the next pending-authorization summary root segment from the IMS database; set end-of-database when none remain.
paragraphs.notes: IMS GN on the summary root.

paragraphs.name: 3000-FIND-NEXT-AUTH-DTL
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read (GNP) the next pending-authorization detail child segment under the current summary; set no-more-auths when the children are exhausted.

paragraphs.name: 4000-CHECK-IF-EXPIRED
paragraphs.pseudocode: Compare the detail's origination/authorization date against today minus the expiry window; if it is older than the window, mark it qualified for delete.

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: a pending-authorization detail expires (is purgeable) once it is older than the expiry window (default 5 days).

paragraphs.name: 5000-DELETE-AUTH-DTL
paragraphs.pseudocode: Delete (DLET) the current pending-authorization detail segment from IMS and count it.
branches: IF IMS delete not OK -> error
paragraphs.notes: IMS DLET of an expired detail.

paragraphs.name: 6000-DELETE-AUTH-SUMMARY
paragraphs.pseudocode: Delete (DLET) the current pending-authorization summary segment from IMS and count it.
branches: IF IMS delete not OK -> error
paragraphs.notes: IMS DLET of an emptied summary.

paragraphs.name: 9000-TAKE-CHECKPOINT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Issue an IMS checkpoint call so the batch job can be restarted from this point, then reset the per-checkpoint counter.

annotations.note: Checkpoint/restart: a CHKP is taken every P-CHKP-FREQ summaries (default 5) for recoverability.
